articles.summary: Tencent BrowserSkill through 0.3.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the local daemon WebSocket origin validation that accepts any chrome-extension origin with 32 characters in range a-p. Attackers can register a malicious extension as a browser client to intercept and manipulate page content, DOM, and screenshots returned to the AI agent.

articles.title: CVE-2026-94108 — CVSS 6.5
articles.summary: getID3 through 1.9.26 contains an XML external entity injection vulnerability in the XML2array helper function that fails to properly disable entity loading on PHP before 8.0. Attackers can craft malicious XML metadata in media files to disclose local files, perform server-side request forgery, or cause denial of service through entity expansion.

articles.title: CVE-2026-94107 — CVSS 8.1
articles.summary: NivoCart through 2.4.0 contains a predictable password reset token vulnerability in the forgotten.php endpoint that generates recovery codes using substr(md5(mt_rand()), 0, 10). Attackers who know an administrator's email address can request a password reset and predict the token to gain administrative account access without rate limiting or expiration.

articles.title: CVE-2026-94106 — CVSS 8.8
articles.summary: getID3 before 1.9.26 contains an OS command injection vulnerability in shell-out handlers that fail to escape filenames in command strings. Attackers can craft malicious filenames containing shell metacharacters to inject arbitrary commands executed with the privileges of the process embedding getID3.

articles.title: CVE-2026-93990 — CVSS 7.5
articles.summary: Expat through 2.8.4 fails to validate low surrogates following high surrogates in UTF-16 input, allowing malformed UTF-16 sequences to be accepted. Attackers can craft UTF-16 encoded XML with lone high surrogates that consume following code units, hiding markup characters from the parser and enabling XML injection attacks.
